notes: TLS Phase 2 hypothesis test (focused session, 2026-04-29): RtS architecture is THREE LAYERS, all location-scoped. (1) Hub passage = pure menu, ~700-1500 chars, no prose. (2) Activity router = ~1200 chars, mostly <<if>> + <<goto>> redirecting to NPC-scene when (RNG x NPC presence x stage flag) match, fallback is one-line stub ('Washing dishes is a boring chore'). (3) Scene passage = 3000-8000 chars, where ALL dialogue/beats/character-development live. Same scene passage covers multiple relationship stages via inline <<if StageOneCorruption>>/<<if StageTwoCorruption>>/<<if StageThreeCorruption>> gates + linkreplace cascades. No separate 'story arc' track exists — even milestones (SchoolGraduation, HouseRob, HouseRobPrison) are location-tagged scene passages, not a separate cutscene/story-event track. NO tags like 'story'/'cutscene'/'oneshot' exist in catalog; all 358 passages tagged by location-background or .menu.
